_doc: Hand-researched evidence for bus stop coordinates; consumed by `python -m hakuba_api.bus.locate_stops`. Each entry has a point under the key `osm`, or an address for GSI to geocode, plus the source it came from. The `osm` key holds a point from any source; its ref prefix (osm:, overture:, resort access point, operator My Maps pin) names the source. No address entries are left: ADR-0004 accepts no GSI result. Licence: ODbL 1.0 for the whole file, © OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture points also keep their own licence; this project modified them (reshaped into this schema, rounded to 5 decimal places). Entries whose ref starts with 'operator My Maps pin' are named exceptions. See DATA-LICENSES.md.

stop-la-naige.note: The hotel has two buildings about 130 m apart, and the boarding point is probably on the road between them. This record is named for the whole hotel and gives 和田野4744, the permit list's lot (4744-1); Meta's east-building record, Hotel La Neige Higashikan (0db10da3, 4744), is 6 m away. The main building's records are 132-134 m away: Meta's Hotel La Neige Honkan (4b97ec54, lot 4748) and Foursquare's ラ・ネージュ本館 (bcb0e324, no lot, only 和田野). Foursquare's ラ・ネージュ東館 (aac113a6, 4744) is 1.2 km away, rejected: 12 unrelated places share its point, so it marks the area, not the hotel

stop-la-vigne-hakuba-north-parking.note: The north car park is not mapped separately, so the point is the hotel's (lot 3020-1116, as on the permit list). A second clean record, Microsoft's ホテル ラ ヴィーニュ 白馬 by 温故知新 (4ca48801), is 505 m away; rejected: its category is automotive_service and its address gives only the district (北城3)

stop-lion-cafe.note: Meta has 2 café records at lot 北城5746-3, 3 m apart; this one equals the stop's name.ja ライオンカフェ, the other is named Lion (6f8d3af9). The food permit list has a second LION CAFE, エコーランドベース, at 北城3020-567; Overture's only record there, 白馬ライオンインドア体験センター (313c3b06), is named for an indoor centre, not the café, and is 1.2 km away. Meta's Lion Adventure (d8b3d94c, 5746-3) is 1.6 km away, rejected: 5 unrelated places share its point

stop-meteor.note: Picked by name and type: this record equals the stop's name.ja ミーティア and is listed as lodging, at lot 北城みそら野2937-730, the permit list's ペンション ミーティア. Meta's Meteor Hakubaミーティア白馬 (f35e3450), a restaurant at the same lot, is 12 m away. Meta's ペンションミーティア (54291d71, same lot) is 220 m away, rejected: 3 unrelated places share its point, so it marks the みそら野 area. Hakuba Valley Pension Meteor Garden (0c0ea809, 917 m) is another property, stop-misorano-ryusei-kaen's
